Privacy Policy

Nothing is collected, so there is nothing to leak

Effective 2 September 2026 · Applies to DressWell (穿好衣) for iOS and Android

1. What we collect

No personal information at all. DressWell has no account system, requires no sign-up or login, and has no developer-operated server. We run no behavioural analytics, embed no advertising or analytics SDK, and never read your contacts, location or device identifiers for profiling.

Put plainly: there is no file about you on our side — not as a promise not to look, but because it does not exist.

2. Where your data lives

Data Stored in Leaves the device?
Avatar parameters (height, body, face, skin tone) App's private sandbox No
Saved looks and their thumbnails App's private sandbox No
Garment photos you upload and the fabric textures built from them App's private sandbox No
The photo used to make the avatar look more like you App's private sandbox No, except as in §3
Optional iCloud backup Your own private iCloud container Only within your Apple account; the developer has no access
The model API key you configure App's private sandbox No, and it is never written to logs

3. The one case where data leaves: your own AI provider

DressWell's AI features are bring-your-own-key. They become available only after you deliberately enter your own model endpoint and key under Settings → AI. When you do:

  • the request — which may include a photo you chose, or a text description of what the avatar is currently wearing — goes directly to the endpoint you entered;
  • retention and use of that data are governed by that provider's privacy policy, which you should read;
  • we hold no key and act as no proxy, so we cannot see the contents of those requests either;
  • without a key the app is fully usable and every AI step falls back to manual input.

Paid stylist skill packs sell bundled prompt templates and include no AI inference credit; inference always runs on your account.

4. Third-party SDKs

Only payment and store components, all provided by the platform and each enabled only in the corresponding build:

Component Purpose What it receives
Apple StoreKit (iOS) In-app purchase and restore Apple handles the transaction; we only learn "purchased / not purchased"
Google Play Billing (Google Play build) Same Google handles the transaction; same as above
Huawei IAP (AppGallery build) Same Huawei handles the transaction; same as above
Apple iCloud (optional) Backup of avatar and custom garments Written to your own private container; the developer has no access

No advertising SDK, no analytics or crash-reporting SDK, and no developer-operated backend API.

5. Permissions

Permission Specific purpose Required?
Camera Photograph your clothes to turn them into wearable 3D garments; on supported iPhones, circle a small object for on-device reconstruction Optional, requested only when used
Photo library Pick a garment photo from your album to extract its colour and pattern Optional, requested only when used

Both are processed on the device and never uploaded. Declining only affects that feature; the fitting room and built-in garments keep working.

6. How to delete your data

  • Settings → Privacy in the app deletes each item individually: saved looks, uploaded garments, and the photo used to shape the avatar. Deletion is local and immediate.
  • Uninstalling the app removes everything in its sandbox.
  • If you enabled iCloud backup, also delete this app's data under Settings → Apple Account → iCloud on your device.

Because we do not hold your data, there is no deletion request to file with us — and no way for us to delete it on your behalf.

7. Children's privacy

This app is not directed at children under 13 and does not knowingly collect personal information from children. Since we collect no personal information at all, there is no data requiring guardian consent.

8. Changes to this policy

If this policy changes we will update this page and the effective date above. Material changes to how data is handled will also be surfaced prominently inside the app.

9. Contact

For privacy questions, email blake.chen94@gmail.com.
